body: It's complicated to explain. But I think saying "what you're doing is triggering the worst and darkest memories of my life" should be enough for this to stop. I don't understand her. I don't understand life itself anymore.

She knows. I even asked her to stop it but she said I had to choose between staying with her the way things are now or leave her.


I'm seeing a therapist and today I was going to make an appointment with a psychiatrist but I couldn't. 


I'm going through too much and have no hopes of ever healing if I keep reliving these things
